about: Regional configuration for scenic shot tours (docs/scenic-tours.md). Geography, named-subject preferences, route anchors and region-dependent parameters live here; DEM sources stay in scenic-views.json. A region's status is its tour's own review state: a view plays its tour in production only when the view and its tour are both approved. Subject lonLat values marked approximate are snapped to the nearest matching DEM feature within snapRadiusM.

budget.trianglesNote: About 18 mesh bytes per triangle plus ~27 MB of surface textures per view; two views are resident across a seam, with forest and sky, inside the low-memory residency budgets (256 MiB desktop, 192 MiB mobile, src/render/GraphicsResidency.js).

nc-ross-lake-north.budgetNote: Wide views over a long lake: each shot brings hundreds of distant tiles (mostly manifest entries), so the default 800 KB fits only three or four shots; raised within the shared Range asset headroom.
nc-ross-lake-north.rebakeOnDriftEvidence: Rail parity after the tour rebake: 0.00% of rail pixels changed at 9 stations (.smoke/scenic-tours/nc-ross-lake-north/rail-parity.json); the drift is below what the rail can show.
nc-ross-lake-north.notes: Ross Lake reservoir between Jack Mountain and the Hozomeen/Pasayten peaks; long north-south water with steep forested flanks.

teton-jackson-lake.budgetNote: Wide views: each shot brings hundreds of distant tiles (mostly manifest entries), so the default 800 KB fits only 3-8 shots; raised within the shared Range asset headroom.
teton-jackson-lake.notes: Jackson Lake under the Teton front: Mount Moran rising straight from the lake, the Grand Teton and Cathedral Group to the south.

denali-wonder-lake.notes: Denali and Mount Foraker above the McKinley River bar and Wonder Lake; enormous relief at long range.

tombstone-north-klondike.blocker: Source drift: the rail-only bake no longer reproduces the approved package (a rebake changes 3.3% of rail pixels), so the package is kept, and it covers no tour shot. Needs the DEM source re-pinned to the approved build (or the rebaked rail re-reviewed and re-approved); then rebuild with scenic tours.
tombstone-north-klondike.notes: Granite spires of the Tombstone Range above tundra valleys of the North Klondike.

muncho-lake-south.notes: Muncho Lake in its valley between the Terminal and Sentinel ranges; the lake is the subject as much as the peaks.

izta-popo-west.notes: Iztaccihuatl and Popocatepetl from the west: two isolated stratovolcanoes over high plateau.

black-mountains-catawba.notes: Forested Black Mountains with Mount Mitchell above the Catawba valley; soft layered ridgelines.

san-gabriel-baldy.notes: Steep chaparral ridges of the San Gabriels around Mount San Antonio (Baldy) and Baden-Powell.

white-mountains-owens.excludeNote: Marked broken in the rendered review of the libraries (docs/scenic-tours.md, Rendered review).
white-mountains-owens.notes: The White Mountains' fault scarp over Owens Valley, White Mountain Peak at the crest.

la-sal-castle-valley.notes: Castle Valley's red-rock towers under the La Sal Mountains; Castle Creek reaches are mapped water.

panamint-dantes-view.notes: Death Valley's salt basin under the Panamint escarpment, Telescope Peak opposite Dantes View.
